notes.title: Dolven v0.9.4 – Release Notes
notes.notes: [p]We’ve been hard at work polishing gameplay, fixing bugs, and adding a few surprises. This update brings:[/p][list][*][p][b]Improved performance[/b] for smoother play.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance tweaks[/b] to make battles more strategic and fun.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual upgrades[/b] to environments and character animations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality-of-life fixes[/b] based on your feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your support and feedback mean are important so please keep sharing your thoughts as we shape the path forward.  [/p][p]See you in the game![/p][p]— The Dev Team[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features Skill Camera[/b] (PR #384) - Introduced dynamic skill camera views to enhance combat visuals and immersion. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Mac Build Support ([/b]PR #392)- Added support for macOS builds, expanding platform availability. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Rogue Skills[/b] (PR #381) -  Changed Aura of Agility from granting Dexterity to granting +1 Action Point for the Rogue class, improving class-specific gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Kaelen Aspen Voiceovers-[/b] Added new voiceover lines for Kaelen Aspen in the Respite Room (thanks @sir_spicyy (2s_Company)), enriching the narrative atmosphere. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Equipment Compare System[/b] -Added the ability to compare items in your bag inventory with currently equipped gear, making it easier to choose upgrades and optimize your loadout. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Quick Tip System[/b] -  Introduced a new Quick Tip system to guide new players with contextual hints, helping them learn mechanics more smoothly. [/p][p][/p][p] [b]Gameplay Improvements Poison Trap Dissipation[/b] (PR #383) - Poison traps now dissipate after a set number of turns, balancing trap mechanics. [/p][p][/p][p] [b]UI Enhancements Larger Tooltips[/b] (PR #382) -  Increased tooltip size for better readability during gameplay. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Skill Camera Positioning[/b] (PR #392 follow-up) -  Adjusted skill cam positions for improved visibility. [/p][p][/p][p] [b]Technical & Build Changes Refactored Build System[/b] (PR #393) Improved build pipeline for stability and maintainability.[/p]

notes.title: A new release of Dolven has been forged!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Brave Wanderers![/b][/p][p]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’re excited to roll out a [b]big update[/b] packed with improvements across the board—from inventory polish and gameplay tweaks to exciting new content.[/p][p]We’re committed to making [i]Dolven[/i] the best experience it can be, and this update is a big step forward. As always, thank you for playing, sharing, and supporting our journey—[b]we’ll see you in the Respite Room[/b].  Stay sharp, mercenaries!

notes.title: Dolven Update 0.6.4
notes.notes:
🎮 Dolven Game Update - March 16, 2025 🎮

Hey Steam! We've got some exciting updates for Dolven. Check out what's new:

🆕 New Features:

Added the Cleric class for all your healing needs!  (Premium/Dev license only)

Archer class now available (Premium/Dev license only)

New miniboss room for extra challenge

Big 6x6 rooms for more epic dungeon layouts

Rest rooms to catch your breath mid-dungeon

Mystery box added for surprise loot!

🎨 UI and Visual Improvements:

Revamped title screen with upscaled background

Room indicators for better navigation

Enhanced tooltips for clearer info

Colored fog to show traversable areas

Cloth physics on character cloaks

⚔️ Gameplay Tweaks:

Balanced character abilities (Araceli's damage buffed!)

Nerfed weapon enchantments for better balance

New deathblow camera effect for epic finishes

🐛 Bug Fixes:

Fixed issues with character selection and loadouts

Resolved problems with boss encounters

Optimized character animations for smoother gameplay

🎵 Audio Updates:

New sound effects for the mystery box

Adjusted guard voice-overs for immersion

Updated music in certain areas

Get ready to dive back in and check out all these awesome changes! Who's hyped for the new Cleric class? 🙌

notes.title: Dolven 0.6.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
We haven't released it to the main branch yet, or the demo as we want to get some play testing in before then. So if you do have a full licensed key you can only see these changes by making sure you select closed_beta as your branch in Steam.

The attached picture below indicates each of the major new additions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/dd5a3b22eadb8761df3548d85c6833dd28433ff4.png[/img]
New Archer Class! (Premium License Only). Skills include:
Aimed Shot: Fire an arrow with precision, guaranteeing a hit and dealing damage to your opponent.
Poison Shot: Afflict your enemy with poison, removing life per turn for 2 turns.
Ricochet: Fire an arrow that will hit an additional adjacent enemy.

New Cleric Class! (Premium License Only). Skills include:
Aura of Light: Emit a radiant aura, healing allies and damaging foes who walk within.
Holy Bolt: Unleash a bolt of holy energy upon your enemy.
Hands Of Life: Reach out to an adjacent friendly character and heal them.

Auras now indicate their range with a glowing tile effect. (All Versions)
Added new console to track movement and afflictions, accessible through the in game settings dialog (more to come here) (All Versions)

Additional Changes (All Versions):

Fixed issue where some female items could not be equipped.
Character portraits are now static, increasing UI performance.
Equipping items is now much faster.
Upgraded underlying Unity Engine to v6000.30.f1


Known issues:

Cleric "Aura Of Light" skill has incorrect description
Cleric "Holy Bolt" has incorrect description

notes.title: DOLVEN DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
🌟 Dolven Demo is LIVE! Test Your Skills and Beat the PAX Record! 🌟

We’re excited to share that the Dolven Beta Demo is now available for download on Steam! Step into the world of Dolven and lead your band of mercenaries on a journey filled with strategic turn-based combat, immersive storytelling, and a unique deck-building experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/3c29b04dabe7b228cfeea3dad28c407580662d05.png[/img]

In This Demo, You’ll Be Able To: ⚔️ Test Your Tactics – Track your performance across battles with scoreboards that reveal your skill in battle!
🃏 Master Deck-Building – Customize your mercenaries with powerful cards and unleash combos that shift the tide in your favor.
🔍 Tackle the Challenge – Keep an eye on how much damage you take, how many turns you need to conquer your foes, and push your score to new heights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/9a15a25b40dfa97dc59b9b8b73c726f6caf470d5.png[/img]

Challenge Accepted? 💪 Tell us how well you did – your scores, the number of turns, damage taken, and any clever strategies! [url=https://t.co/0cnkh0fMS3]Join our community on Discord[/url] to share your stats, hear tips from others, and maybe even score a few bragging rights!  We will have competitions and giveaways active on our Discord channel. 

We look forward to seeing you there! 🌟

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43966913/c00a00b35ded6725e0bca2b384d3c9c4bc4f6fd1.png[/img]
